query: INSERT INTO open_ticket_items (id, org_id, open_ticket_id, round_id, menu_item_id, line, line_total) SELECT u.id, $1, $2, $3, u.menu_item_id, u.line, u.line_total FROM UNNEST($4::uuid[], $5::uuid[], $6::jsonb[], $7::int4[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(id, menu_item_id, line, line_total, ord) ORDER BY u.ord
